scope: ALL atlas_packets (not only the current admitted cohort)

contract.L1_LINEAGE: packet_key, source_ref, source_revision (whole-file hash by construction); packet.sha256, when present, must agree with it (sha256 alone is not required: it is populated on only 7.6% of packets)
contract.L4_EMBED_OK: real non-shared embedding + embedding_version + non-legacy representation_revision; only reachable after L1+L2
contract.L5_PROJECT: community_id + kmeans + SOM cell + pagerank (projection metadata, never identity)

preEmbeddingGate.rule: EmbeddingGemma fan-out and graph creation consume only packets with L1+L2(+L3) met; others are recorded as embedding_blocked with the first unmet level, never given a default/shared vector
preEmbeddingGate.existingFailure: a shared placeholder vector was stored for packets with no summary (July 20-21 run), making embedding presence meaningless
preEmbeddingGate.wiring: not yet wired; graphify-langgraph-pipeline.mjs has uncommitted edits by another session, so the gate is specified as a task, not patched here
